name: Lukas Mandl, Pierfrancesco Maran - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the implementation and delivery of the Sustainable Development Goals in view of the 2026 High-Level Political Forum
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the European Union to keep its promises on the Sustainable Development Goals, the 17 global targets agreed at the United Nations for 2030. It asks for more money and action on clean water and sanitation, affordable clean energy, resilient infrastructure, sustainable cities and global partnerships. It also wants the European Union to lead international efforts, fill the gap left by cuts to United States aid, and set new targets beyond 2030. This is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- The European Union is urged to spend more on water, energy, infrastructure and cities, and to meet its aid spending promises.
- It affects people in poorer countries, especially women, children and disabled people, and European taxpayers and aid budgets.
- Next, the European Union takes these demands into the 2026 United Nations meeting and future budget talks.
